_readme: Progression data. chapters: major story flags (a chapter can also be reached through reachedWhen, or by a quest/trigger effect setChapter). missionGates: { missionId: { visible?: Condition, unlock?: Condition } } - a mission listed here is hidden until `visible` holds, then shown-but-locked until `unlock` holds; a mission NOT listed here keeps its normal chapter-by-chapter chain. triggers: [{ when: Condition, do: [Effect] }] fire whenever the save changes. See progression.ts for the condition and effect vocabulary.
